title: core-unit-bioinformatics/workflow-nxf-somatic-variantcomp pipeline - params.known_variants schema
description: Comma-separated sheet of known variant lists. Relative paths are resolved against the sheet's directory.

name.errorMessage: name must be provided and may only contain A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '_', '.' and '-'

sample.errorMessage: sample must be a samplesheet sample or 'all'

mode.errorMessage: mode must be 'required' (every variant must be found in every technology) or 'benchmark' (external truth set)

variants.errorMessage: variants must be one or more VCF/CSV/TSV files separated by ';'

regions.errorMessage: regions must be a BED file or 'n/a' (e.g. confident regions of a truth set)
